newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Labor's Reich said to be mulling his options.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Labor's Reich said to be mulling his options.

text.p: U.S. Labor Secretary Robert Reich has not decided yet whether he will leave the Clinton administration to return to private life or continue in his current position, a department official said Thursday.
"He's mulling his options right now," the official told Reuters. "He legitimately has not decided what he wants to do."
Asked when Reich would be making a decision, the official replied "soon."
